shape: a place box that takes only a suggestion and searches on keydown: the applicant's saved place carries a country code ("Zürich, CHE") that no place search matches
why: 15 Oct 2026, Lever's own script in a bake-off recording: the box searched only on keydown and kept a place only when a suggestion was pressed; the extension typed the text without a key and the box emptied itself when focus left (and a nearby place was always the first suggestion)

control.guard: new case; fails on the build before this change (the place is typed as plain text, no suggestion is ever pressed, and the box empties itself when the person moves on)

sample: hand-cut page of the shape (invented place names; the page's own script stands in for its server)
